notes: Cats: the Régionale bank's Sake & Spirits (64 stems, 31 on distillation, brandy, whisky, agave, cane, gin, vodka and liqueurs) and the Village bank's Spirits & Cocktails (54 stems, 48 on spirits, liqueurs and aromatised wines, 6 on cocktails). Chapters: the Régionale Spirits & Liqueurs chapter (what the still does; the categories by raw material) and the Village Spirits & Cocktails chapter (Cognac; Armagnac and Calvados; whisky old and new world; agave; clear and botanical; pomace, pisco and vermouth). No region article teaches Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados, tequila or mezcal (the france record names Ugni Blanc as a distilling grape in one line, the elqui-limari article Chile's pisco, which the Court does not list), and Ugni Blanc, Colombard, Folle Blanche and Baco have no grape record, so no region, country or grape is mapped; no technique in the roster is a distilling one. Service tables: spirits (one row per category, raw material, place, still and styles) and digestifs (Cognac, Armagnac and Calvados age terms, eaux de vie, grappa and marc, Chartreuse, Bénédictine, the orange liqueurs, sambuca).
